context: Two cafe friends recap a moving wedding ceremony
purpose: Teach: 瞳/斜め/今頃/抱く/癒さ/つくづく/到底/ツボ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: さっきの式、新婦の瞳がずっと潤んでてさ、こっちまでもらい泣きしちゃった。
lines.en: The bride's eyes were glistening the whole time — I ended up tearing up too.
lines.style: warm reflective tone, slightly hushed as if still moved

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: わかる…私たち斜め前の席だったから、表情が全部見えて、つくづく愛されてる人なんだなって感じた。
lines.en: I know — we were seated diagonally in front, so we could see every expression. I really felt how loved she is.
lines.style: soft sighing delivery, savoring the memory with quiet intensity

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 新郎の誓いの言葉、今頃思い出しても泣けるよ。あんなまっすぐな言葉、到底自分には言えないなって。
lines.en: Even now, recalling the groom's vows makes me tear up. I could never say something that earnest myself.
lines.style: self-deprecating chuckle midway, voice cracking on the last clause

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でもね、指輪を渡すとき手が震えてたの、あれが完全に私の笑いのツボでさ、泣きながら吹き出しちゃった。
lines.en: But when he was handing over the ring his hands were shaking — that totally hit my funny bone, I laughed while crying.
lines.style: stifled giggle, embarrassed and affectionate at once

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 見た見た。お父さんが花嫁を抱くみたいに支えてバージンロード歩いてたとこも、もう反則だったよね。
lines.en: I saw that. And the father practically holding the bride as they walked the aisle — that was just unfair.
lines.style: leaning forward eagerly, voice thick with shared emotion

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ほんと反則。ああいうの見ると心が癒されるっていうか、人生捨てたもんじゃないなって思えるよね。
lines.en: Totally unfair. Watching things like that genuinely soothes the heart — makes you feel life isn't so bad after all.
lines.style: wistful and dreamy, trailing off into a contented sigh

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: わかる。帰り道、空を見上げてさ、いつか自分もあんな式挙げたいなって、ちょっと夢を抱いちゃった。
lines.en: Right? On the way home I looked up at the sky and let myself dream a little about having a wedding like that someday.
lines.style: shy admission, voice softening near the end with hopeful warmth
